name: PFMBench
description: PFMBench is a comprehensive benchmark evaluating protein foundation models across 38 tasks spanning 8 key areas of protein science. It aims to provide fair evaluation and in-depth understanding of protein foundation models' generalization and limitations.
reputation: A recent, comprehensive benchmark that is gaining attention in the protein ML community for broad, fair evaluation across many protein science tasks.
notes: Evaluates 17 state-of-the-art models; provides streamlined evaluation protocol; code to be released upon acceptance.
